subject: GreenLoop contract onboarding and redline sprint
content:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@greenloop.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@greenloop.io
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MSA + Order Form — starting intake

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the intro call earlier — appreciate you moving quickly. Attached are GreenLoop's preferred MSA (GreenLoop_MSA_v1.pdf) and our populated order form (GreenLoop_OrderForm_20261118.xlsx).

Quick asks from our side to help us scope reviews and timelines:
- Can Redwood provide the template you expect to use for signature (if different from attached MSA)?
- Any known non-starters (data residency, indemnity caps, or IP assignments) we should avoid redlining now?
- What is the expected turnaround for an initial redline + comment pass (we're aiming for a week if possible)?

Our procurement team (Tom Reed in cc) will own commercial points; legal will track MSA redlines. If you prefer, we can accept comments in a single consolidated PDF or tracked Word — let us know your preference.

Attachments: [attachment: GreenLoop_MSA_v1.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: GreenLoop_OrderForm_20261118.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Head of Legal Operations
GreenLoop Inc.

---

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@greenloop.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — starting intake

Hi Aisha — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. We're glad to move forward. Quick replies inline: 

- Template: We usually start from Redwood Master Services Agreement (we'll attach our canonical MSA template). Could you confirm whether the attached GreenLoop_MSA_v1 is preferred to be the execution copy or if you prefer us to propose majority of the contract language?
- Non-starters: At a high level, Redwood cannot accept unrestricted data egress to third parties and we have a liability cap tied to fees; we can flag specifics after I run a quick scan.
- Turnaround: Internal SLA for an initial redline + comment pass is 5 business days once legal has the final order form and MSA you want us to use as the baseline.

Plan: I'll do a technical/legal triage today and route to Kimberly (contracts) for clause-level redlines; Marissa will coordinate billing/contact details for order form items and signer flow. Expect our initial pass by end-of-day next Wednesday (2026-11-25) unless GreenLoop requests an expedited turnaround.

I'll attach: Redwood_MSA_template_v2026-10.pdf and a simple intake checklist for faster intake.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Contracts Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: [attachment: Redwood_MSA_template_v2026-10.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: onboarding-intake-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — starting intake

Looping in the contracting checklist and assigning clause owners. Notes from my quick read of GreenLoop_MSA_v1.pdf:
- Sec. 6 (Indemnity) trims Redwood's IP carveouts; will propose language to preserve Redwood's model/IP rights.
- Sec. 9 (Data Residency & Subprocessors) requests EU-only residency for logs; need to confirm which products will be in scope.
- Sec. 11 (Liability Cap) asks for a cap tied to annual spend — will propose a standard cap tied to 12 months' fees with carveouts for breach of confidentiality.

Action items: 
1) Marissa: confirm billing PO and payer details from Tom.
2) Olga: run the MSA through our template-merge to produce tracked Word for GreenLoop to review.
3) I'll draft proposed language for indemnity, liability cap, and subprocessors by 11/20.

If GreenLoop wants to accelerate, we can push a lean redline just to get commercial sign-off and parallelize technical SAs.

Thanks — K

---

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@procureco.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@greenloop.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — starting intake

Thanks all — procurement note: GreenLoop prefers the Order Form to list seat counts and forecasted burst capacity (month-by-month estimate). Marissa, can you confirm whether Redwood needs a committed minimum or if we can accept a forecast and convert to committed seats later? Also, GreenLoop requests a 45-day invoice term on first-year orders; that's a commercial ask, not legal.

Aisha — if you prefer we can set up an internal demo for the billing team to validate usage metrics before finalizing the order form.

Tom Reed
Sr. Sourcing Manager (ProcureCo)

---

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@greenloop.io>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@procureco.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — starting intake

Thanks everyone — short update and next steps: 
- Kimberly: please include the tracked Word (Redwood_MSA_template_merged_GL_v1.docx) in the next outbound.
- Marissa: I'll need a short summary of commercial flex (commit vs forecast) for the contracting log by EOD 11/19 so we can reflect it in liability/termination drafts.
- Aisha/Tom: we can accept forecasts in the Order Form with an optional conversion to committed within 90 days; I'll flag that as a commercial term to legal and procurement (Marissa to confirm).

Proposed timeline:
- 11/19: Redwood provides tracked redline Word + clause owner notes to GreenLoop.
- 11/23: GreenLoop reviews and returns prioritized comments.
- 11/25: Target internal approval window for commercial/legal.

If GreenLoop needs earlier turnaround we can prioritize the liability and data residency items and push the rest into a separate sprint.

Best regards,
Olga
Contracts Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Quoted/forwarded content preserved above (oldest -> newest).
